title: JetBrains Air — Agentic Development Cheat Sheet
brandSub: Cloud Tasks · Automations · Multi-Agent Orchestration · MCP

rows.label: What is Air
rows.value: Agentic Development Environment — delegate coding tasks to AI agents, review & steer them

rows.label: Install macOS
rows.value: Download from air.dev or via JetBrains Toolbox

rows.label: Install Linux
rows.value: curl -fsSL https://jb.gg/air-install.sh | sh

rows.label: Install Windows
rows.value: Install via JetBrains Toolbox

rows.label: Web version
rows.value: https://air.jetbrains.cloud — cloud tasks & automations, no local setup

rows.label: Connect provider
rows.value: Settings Ctrl+, → Account | AI Providers → Connect

rows.label: JetBrains AI sub
rows.value: One subscription unlocks Claude Agent, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Junie via AI credits

rows.label: BYOK / own account
rows.value: Connect Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google directly with subscription or API key

rows.label: Cloud tasks (EAP)
rows.value: Run tasks in remote containerized environments; results pushed to air/<task> branch

rows.label: Automations (EAP)
rows.value: Schedule- or event-driven cloud tasks managed at https://air.jetbrains.cloud

rows.label: MCP Connectors (EAP)
rows.value: Managed GUI connections to MCP servers — no mcp.json required

rows.label: Projects (EAP)
rows.value: Team-scoped environments, automations, connectors, and shared AI credits

rows.label: Cloud env lifecycle
rows.value: Suspended after 75 min idle; archived after 24 h — results safe on task branch

rows.label: Resume suspended
rows.value: Open task → click Resume; working tree, packages & caches restored from snapshot

rows.label: Multi-repo (EAP)
rows.value: Clone extra repos via .air/cloud/startup.sh using credential helper workaround

rows.label: IDE integration
rows.value: Start cloud tasks from AI Assistant in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, etc.

rows.label: New task
rows.value: Open Chat tool → describe goal → press Enter or click Send

rows.label: Run in parallel
rows.value: Press Ctrl+N or Tasks tool → New Task to start multiple agents simultaneously

rows.label: Change statistics
rows.value: After task done, Chat shows +N -M lines — click to open diff in Task Changes tab

rows.label: Input required
rows.value: Task pauses with Input required state — open task, provide input, or switch to another

rows.label: Task states
rows.value: Draft → Running → Review required → Done / Suspended / Problem

rows.label: Voice input
rows.value: Settings → Voice Input → Download Whisper model; click mic icon in Chat (local, no cloud audio)

rows.label: Slash commands
rows.value: Type / in task input to open slash menu: commands, skills, review, upload

rows.label: Group tasks
rows.value: Tasks tool → settings icon → group by Date, Status, or Target

rows.label: @-mention
rows.value: Type @ in Chat to attach files, folders, symbols, Git branches, commits, or terminal

rows.label: Add from editor
rows.value: Select code → right-click → Add to Task to attach the exact snippet

rows.label: Add comment
rows.value: Select code → right-click → Add Comment for Selection for follow-up feedback

rows.label: Upload file
rows.value: Type / → Upload File from Computer to attach logs, screenshots, or specs

rows.label: Search as context
rows.value: Run a search in the Search tool → click Add Search Results to Task

rows.label: Project instructions
rows.value: Agent reads CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/settings.json from project root automatically

rows.label: Skills
rows.value: Reusable modules in .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; agent selects relevant ones per task

rows.label: Symbols scope
rows.value: Symbol picker shows only symbols from files already open in the editor

rows.label: Local Workspace
rows.value: Agent edits files directly in your working copy — fastest startup, no isolation

rows.label: Git Worktree
rows.value: Separate branch air/<task> in isolated working copy; configure via .air/worktree.json

rows.label: Docker
rows.value: Full container isolation; configure image & env in .air/docker.json

rows.label: Cloud (EAP)
rows.value: Remote JetBrains-managed container; select in task header or at air.jetbrains.cloud

rows.label: Default cloud image
rows.value: Includes almost all common tools & frameworks when no custom config is set

rows.label: Startup script
rows.value: .air/cloud/startup.sh — runs after repo clone, before agent; must be idempotent

rows.label: Cloud VM sizes
rows.value: Small (2 CPU/8 GB), Medium (4/16), Large (8/32), Extra Large (16 CPU/64 GB/100 GB disk)

rows.label: Docker custom image
rows.value: Requires Git + /bin/sh; set image or build.dockerfile in .air/docker.json

rows.label: Permission: Plan
rows.value: Agent writes plan to .air/plans/; click Implement to approve before code changes

rows.label: Permission: Ask
rows.value: Agent requests approval before each file edit or command (Ask Permission / Default / Chat)

rows.label: Permission: Edit
rows.value: Agent edits files automatically with moderate restrictions (Auto-Edit / Agent)

rows.label: Permission: Full Access
rows.value: Fewest restrictions for trusted projects — use with care

rows.label: Cycle modes
rows.value: Press Shift+Tab in Chat to cycle through permission modes

rows.label: Effort / Thinking
rows.value: Set reasoning depth: Low / Medium / High / Max — higher uses more tokens & time

rows.label: Switch model mid-task
rows.value: Model can be changed after task starts; agent (provider) cannot be switched mid-task

rows.label: Follow-up messages
rows.value: Type in Chat after task done to iterate; agent retains full task context

rows.label: Open diff
rows.value: Click change statistics (+N -M) in Chat to open Task Changes editor tab

rows.label: Diff views
rows.value: Toggle Unified / Side-by-side in diff header; use hunk navigation controls

rows.label: Agentic review
rows.value: Click Review with <agent> in Chat or diff header — runs separate review session

rows.label: Different reviewer
rows.value: Click arrow next to Review button → choose a different agent for independent second opinion

rows.label: Review scope via /
rows.value: Type / → Review with agent → choose Task Changes, Local Changes, files, commits, or branches

rows.label: Review prompt (global)
rows.value: Review menu → Edit Review Prompt or Settings → Global → AI | Review

rows.label: Review prompt (project)
rows.value: Stored in .air/review/review-prompt.md; overrides global prompt for that repo

rows.label: Send comments
rows.value: Comments tool → select accepted comments → click Send to pass to agent as follow-up

rows.label: Local workspace
rows.value: Changes already in working copy — select files in Changes tool, commit & push

rows.label: Generate commit msg
rows.value: Click Generate Commit Message icon next to Commit in Changes tool

rows.label: Apply Locally
rows.value: In Task Changes tab → Apply Locally — copies worktree/Docker changes to working copy

rows.label: Check Out Branch
rows.value: Apply Locally drop-down → Check Out Branch Locally — creates air/<task>-copy branch

rows.label: Cloud task PR
rows.value: Click Create PR in task — agent has already pushed changes to air/<task> branch

rows.label: Revert single file
rows.value: Changes tool → Task Changes tab → click Revert icon next to filename

rows.label: Revert all
rows.value: Changes tool → Task Changes tab → click Revert All icon

rows.label: Roll back branch
rows.value: History tool → right-click commit → Reset Current Branch To Here → choose Mixed/Keep/Hard

rows.label: Built-in agents
rows.value: Claude Agent (Anthropic), OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI (Google), Junie (JetBrains)

rows.label: ACP custom agents
rows.value: Add any ACP-compatible agent via acp.json; action: Edit ACP JSON File (Ctrl+Shift+K)

rows.label: acp.json format
rows.value: {"agent_servers":{"Name":{"command":"...","args":["..."]}}}

rows.label: Model selector
rows.value: Click model name (e.g. Sonnet 4.5) in task toolbar to change agent & model

rows.label: Cloud agent limit
rows.value: Cloud tasks only use agents enabled by org admin in JetBrains Central Console

rows.label: Gemini cloud caveat
rows.value: Gemini CLI temporarily unavailable for cloud tasks

rows.label: Claude in Docker
rows.value: Claude Agent can't use subscription in Docker — falls back to Anthropic API billing or JB AI credits

rows.label: Add agent
rows.value: Model selector → Add Agent → Settings opens at Account | AI Providers

rows.label: Enable MCP
rows.value: Settings → AI | MCP Servers → toggle Enable MCP support

rows.label: Global MCP server
rows.value: Settings → AI | MCP Servers → Add Global MCP Server — available in all projects

rows.label: Local MCP config
rows.value: .air/mcp.json in project root — project-scoped, commit to share with team

rows.label: Workspace MCP
rows.value: Standard .mcp.json in repo root; enable Launch workspace MCP servers in Settings

rows.label: Bearer token auth
rows.value: Provide token directly in mcp.json headers — env-var tokens not supported

rows.label: Connectors (EAP)
rows.value: GUI alternative to mcp.json: web Settings → Connectors → Connect service

rows.label: Project connectors
rows.value: Project page → Add Connector — sign in with shared org account, not personal

rows.label: GitHub connector
rows.value: Always enabled for automations; GitHub MCP server always available to automation agent

rows.label: Create automation
rows.value: air.jetbrains.cloud → Automations page → New Automation

rows.label: Trigger types
rows.value: Schedule (At time), Repeat every interval, GitHub PR/issue/workflow events, Incoming webhook

rows.label: Webhook trigger
rows.value: POST .../api/v1/events/automations/<id> with Authorization: ApiKey <token>

rows.label: Change handling
rows.value: Per trigger: No code changes, Push to source branch, Push to new branch, or Create a PR

rows.label: Run manually
rows.value: Automations page → automation → Run Now — choose branch, change handling, context

rows.label: Pause / Resume
rows.value: Automation menu → Pause to freeze triggers; Resume to re-enable

rows.label: Outgoing webhook
rows.value: Add Notification → Webhook URL; Slack URLs get slack-workflow flat JSON format

rows.label: Personal vs project
rows.value: Personal automation spends your AI credits; project automation spends project service account credits

rows.label: Connect GitHub
rows.value: Web Settings → VCS Providers → Connect → install JetBrains Air GitHub App for org

rows.label: Connect GitLab
rows.value: OAuth authorization only — no app install; all accessible repos available immediately

rows.label: GitHub org repos
rows.value: Admin installs app in GitHub; then each user authorizes; org internal repos need explicit access

rows.label: Manage repo access
rows.value: Web Settings → VCS Providers → Settings → choose All repositories or select specific ones

rows.label: Cloud env variables
rows.value: Settings → Environments → Add Variable: plain text, personal secret (encrypted), or shared secret

rows.label: Internet access modes
rows.value: Off / Specified domains / Trusted domains (preset list) / All domains — pick narrowest

rows.label: Projects page
rows.value: air.jetbrains.cloud → Projects — group environments, automations, connectors per team

rows.label: Org AI governance
rows.value: JetBrains Central Console → AI Governance → set credit limits, allowed agents, cloud task access

rows.label: Push
rows.value: Ctrl+Shift+G, Ctrl+Shift+P or Git menu → Push

rows.label: Pull
rows.value: Ctrl+Shift+G, Ctrl+Shift+U or Git menu → Pull

rows.label: Sync (pull + push)
rows.value: Git menu → Sync — use when branch has drifted apart on both sides

rows.label: Branch selector
rows.value: Click branch name in task header — shows ↑ ahead / ↓ behind counters

rows.label: New branch
rows.value: Branch selector → Create New Branch (checks out automatically)

rows.label: File history
rows.value: Ctrl+Shift+G, Ctrl+Shift+H or Git menu → Current File | File History

rows.label: Git Blame
rows.value: Git menu → Current File | Toggle Git Blame (Ctrl+Shift+G, Ctrl+Shift+A)

rows.label: Auto-fetch
rows.value: Settings → Tools | Git → enable Auto-fetch repositories to keep ↑↓ counters fresh

rows.label: Go to All
rows.value: Ctrl+K or Shift+Shift — search files, symbols, actions, and tools in one popup

rows.label: Find action
rows.value: Ctrl+Shift+K — run any action by name, e.g. Edit ACP JSON File

rows.label: Find in files
rows.value: Ctrl+Shift+F — text search across project; Ctrl+Shift+H to replace

rows.label: Find usages
rows.value: Ctrl+U with caret on symbol — language-aware usage list

rows.label: Go to definition
rows.value: Ctrl+B — jump to symbol definition (LSP-backed languages)

rows.label: Go to implementations
rows.value: Alt+Shift+B — list implementations of interface/abstract symbol

rows.label: Next / prev problem
rows.value: Ctrl+E / Ctrl+Shift+E — navigate errors & warnings in file

rows.label: Open in IDE
rows.value: Top-right IDE selector → pick installed IntelliJ-based IDE for debugging & advanced refactoring

rows.label: .air/settings.json
rows.value: Workspace settings: excluded paths, visual guides, terminal profiles

rows.label: .air/worktree.json
rows.value: Worktree env vars (environment) and setup / cleanup commands per OS

rows.label: .air/docker.json
rows.value: Docker image / build, user, environment, and setup commands

rows.label: .air/mcp.json
rows.value: Project-scoped MCP server config; committed to share with team

rows.label: .air/review/review-prompt.md
rows.value: Project-specific agentic review instructions — overrides global review prompt

rows.label: .air/cloud/startup.sh
rows.value: Cloud pre-agent setup script; runs on every env start — must be idempotent

rows.label: .air/plans/
rows.value: Directory where Plan mode writes Markdown implementation plans

rows.label: Custom commands
rows.value: Claude: .claude/commands/<name>.md · Gemini: .gemini/commands/<name>.toml · Junie: .junie/commands/<name>.md

rows.label: Check JB credits
rows.value: Settings menu (bottom of tool panel) → counter shows usage & reset date

rows.label: Web credits
rows.value: air.jetbrains.cloud → Settings → Account — shows remaining credit limit

rows.label: Own account priority
rows.value: Local tasks: your own provider account is used before JetBrains AI credits

rows.label: Cloud always JB AI
rows.value: Cloud tasks always spend JetBrains AI credits — own provider accounts not usable

rows.label: Org credit limits
rows.value: JetBrains Central Console → AI Governance | Settings → set per-user monthly limit

rows.label: Audit & policy
rows.value: Central Console → AI Governance | Policies — restrict agents, cloud tasks, MCP connectors

rows.label: Project service acct
rows.value: Each project gets auto-created service account in Central Console; project automations bill it

rows.label: Docs updated
rows.value: Latest docs scraped: 2026-08-25
